---
title: "Roxygen suggestions"
description: "Claude reviews and rewrites roxygen2 documentation."
---

`roxygen-suggest.yml` has Claude review each changed function's roxygen2
block for completeness and accuracy against its code, and proposes an
improved block as a [suggestion PR](suggestions.qmd).

## What it changes

- **Only six parts are rewritten**: title, description, details,
  parameters, return value and examples. Every other tag — `@export`,
  `@importFrom`, `@seealso`, `@rdname`, … — is kept exactly as written.
- **Exported and internal functions** get different guidance, e.g. examples
  are required only for exported ones.
- **Style**: explicit `@title` / `@description` tags, tags in a fixed
  order, examples wrapped in `\dontrun{}`. Order and guidance are set in
  `config/roxygen-style.json` and can be
  [overridden](suggestions.qmd#adjusting-the-guidance).
- **One function per file** is assumed: only the first function of a file
  is reviewed.

- **Only real improvements**: Claude gives a reason for every change.
  Changes that only make correct text clearer or restyle it are dropped,
  as are changes in whitespace, punctuation or case only — those parts
  keep your original lines. See
  [what gets proposed](suggestions.qmd#what-gets-proposed).

If a block is already adequate, nothing is proposed.

## DataSHIELD packages

With `datashield: true`, Claude gets role-specific guidance for client or
server packages (`datashield-type`), e.g. about disclosure control. Client
packages listed in `config/datashield-example-env.json` also get a
ready-made multi-study login to the Opal demo server for their examples.
